I inspected the chart image you provided. The axis labels and tick numbers are too blurry to read, so I cannot determine the exact numeric value of the tallest bar from this image.

What I can do next (pick one):
- Try a best-effort visual estimate (I’ll measure bar height in pixels and map it to the axis if any tick marks or gridlines are legible). This will be approximate and I’ll give a plausibility range and note uncertainty.
- Attempt simple image enhancement/cropping to improve legibility (may or may not recover the labels).
- If you can, upload a higher-resolution/uncropped version of the chart or the underlying data (CSV or numbers). With that I can give an exact value.

Which would you prefer?
